jsch generate --schema schema.json --out ./model --package model --type Doc

exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "$defs": {
    "Named": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {"name": {"type": "string"}},
      "required": ["name"]
    },
    "Stamped": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {"stamp": {"type": "string"}},
      "required": ["stamp"]
    },
    "NamedAndStamped": {
      "allOf": [
        {"$ref": "#/$defs/Named"},
        {"$ref": "#/$defs/Stamped"}
      ]
    }
  },
  "allOf": [
    {"$ref": "#/$defs/Named"},
    {"$ref": "#/$defs/NamedAndStamped"}
  ]
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/siblingpkg

go 1.26
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"testing"
)

func TestDoc_SiblingRefMergedNotCycle(t *testing.T) {
	in := []byte(`{"name":"alice","stamp":"2020"}`)
	var d Doc
	if err := json.Unmarshal(in, &d); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	if d.Name != "alice" {
		t.Errorf("Name = %q, want alice", d.Name)
	}
	if d.Stamp != "2020" {
		t.Errorf("Stamp = %q, want 2020", d.Stamp)
	}
}
